name: Bandits
description: *You've got money, they want money… a perfect match! (hand it over)*

sharedAbility.name: Parry
sharedAbility.description: Treat attacks against you that roll 2 as a miss.

potentialLoot: VERY valuable item (stolen; its owner may come looking for it, or reward you for its return), kidnapped person, leather armor, chipped blades, old food, fine art or clothes, wagon load of some commodity (salt, nails, wool, etc.), coded letter from a secretive client.
